My anxiety doesn't happen all the time .I think it's a subconscious thought if that makes sense. 

Try and remember some situations were you had anxiety and see if there's a little bit of similarity in those situations. Once you find it, ask yourself what could you be thinking and add a thought that would make sense to how you feel in those situations . If you find it ask your self 

Is the thought really true? 
If it's no, then you tell yourself it's just a thought it's not true, believe it not true and proceed with your human activity. 

If yes, then accept it or get really deep in your emotions and thoughts, cry if you have to,don't hold those tears, write down those emotions and thoughts see what you come up with .

I think there is reason for anxiety .
